text_block_list.text:
Time flies after Бива Хаяхидэ's debut,
and
before we know it, the Asahi Hai
F.S. has arrived.

My uniform is impeccable, and I just
checked my
cleats earlier...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Ngh... I can't help that I am.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
This is a G1 race. It's my first time
running in such
a large competition.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I want to make sure everything is perfect
to make
the most of this opportunity.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'd best get out there.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Aaand next up in the paddock is Biwa
Hayahide!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Even the crowd is louder at a G1, and
I'm pretty
sure I spot a few live
broadcast cameras set up.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: A lot of eyes will be on this race. I wonder if she's watching too...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter. Either way, I don't
intend to
lose.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
